Protein Food

Lamb Tenderloin

About This Entry

Lamb tenderloin is the most tender lamb cut — small, lean, and quick-cooking. Delicate flavor pairs with lighter reds (Pinot Noir, Gamay), dry rosé, and aromatic whites.

Beginner Guide

Two small tenderloins sit inside the loin. Sear fast over high heat; a short rest is essential on this lean cut.

FAQ

What is Lamb Tenderloin?
Two small tenderloins sit inside the loin.
How should Lamb Tenderloin be cooked for best results?
Match cooking method to cut — quick heat for tender muscles, slow moist heat for collagen-rich cuts. Rest roasts before slicing.
